description: This map shows a prediction of the number of the houses in any one area that are likely to have high radon levels. Those areas in red are most at risk from radon and are called High Radon Areas. The map is based on an analysis of indoor radon measurements plus geological information including, bedrock type, quaternary geology, soil permeability and aquifer type. The areas of the map in orange and yellow are areas of medium and low risk respectively..

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry in WGS 84 (OGC:CRS84) after conversion; the service stores it in TM65 / Irish Grid (EPSG:29902). The only column declared as geometry.

table:columns.name: Risk
table:columns.description: Radon risk statement the EPA publishes for the area, phrased as the share of homes likely to have high radon levels (for example "About 1 in 10 homes in this area is likely to have high radon levels").

table:columns.name: URL
table:columns.description: Link to the EPA radon testing page the publisher attaches to the area.

table:columns.name: URLtext
table:columns.description: Display label for the URL column, "Test your home" throughout.
